source_title: OSHA Technical Manual Section III, Chapter 5: Noise
source_excerpt: Typical Sound Levels (dBA) - From bottom to top (blue to red in color): Noise, 0 - Threshold of Hearing (1000hz), 10, 20 - Silent Study Room, 30, North Rim of Grand Cayon, 40 - Soft Whisper (5 ft. away), 50 - Urban Residence, 60 - Conversation (3 ft. away), 70 - Classroom Chatter, 80 - Freight Train (100 ft. away), 90 - Boiler Room, 100 - Construction Site, 110 - Night Club (w/ music), 120 - Operating Heavy Equipment, 130 - Jet Taking Off (200 ft. away), 140 - Threshold of Pain.
